verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Ryzen AI NPU/LLM software stack, quantization tools, memory bandwidth, and TDP specs, but contains no mention of media/video encode-decode engines, AV1/HEVC/ProRes hardware acceleration, or any streaming/editing codec support. This is an applicable axis for a creator-focused chip (media engines are a standard spec area for APUs), but no documentation or community evidence confirms it here.
